rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for metaphorical adaptability and for having room to adjust plans or arrangements.

example.english: This contract has flexibility, so the timing can still be adjusted.
example.traditional: 呢份合約有彈性，時間安排可以再傾。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jau5 daan6 sing3 si4 gaan1 on1 paai4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 king1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the physical flexibility of a body or material rather than flexibility in plans.

example.english: Doing yoga can improve the body's flexibility.
example.traditional: 做瑜伽可以提升身體嘅柔軟度。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyu4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 san1 tai2 ge3 jau4 jyun5 dou6
